prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of a single zine protest page on cheap red-tinted copier paper under overhead fluorescent light. Drum-line streaks visible. Paper slightly wrinkled from hurry.

Subject:
A protest graphic page featuring a bold torn-paper hand silhouette in black, three cut-out slogan blocks made of mismatched letterforms, a crude marker star, and a photocopied crowd-silhouette enlarged beyond photocopy resolution so the pixels are visibly grainy blocks. Scissor-trim corner, scribbled ballpoint marginalia in dark blue.

Important details:
The red paper must be slightly pink from age, not digital red. The black hand silhouette must be actually torn, not cut — fibrous tear line. The pixel-grainy crowd silhouette must look like over-enlarged photocopy, not digital rasterization. Marker star shows uneven wet edges.

Use case:
Independent single image in the Collage Moods package, representing the activist protest voice.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no political party symbols, no actual political slogans, no vector shapes, no clean edges, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
